violated_contract: A binding lookup keyed by an identity must resolve exactly that identity. When the stored document id hashes only the identity, probing a fallback identity after a miss returns a document owned by a different principal, and the caller treats it as the requested one. A Telegram/Sendblue group with no binding of its own fell through to the sender's personal DM binding, so the router answered from that person's private account, with their private context, into a shared group, and a group unlink revoked their personal binding.
canonical_prevention: Resolve one identity per lookup and reject a document whose stored identity is not the one asked for, rather than probing alternates in sequence. A behavioral test must drive the production lookup for a group whose binding is absent while a member's personal binding exists, and assert the lookup returns nothing.
